intro: Timeless and tidy, our Upmond bedside table keeps essentials right beside you while elevating your room with rich, neutral tones.

features.title: Smart dual storage design
features.text: Keep items hidden in drawers or display them on open shelves—because both practicality and style deserve space.

features.title: Durable, stylish build
features.text: PU-coated surfaces and a PLT carcass make this unit not just durable, but beautifully finished for everyday use.

features.title: Compact yet spacious
features.text: Small in footprint, generous in function—it fits snugly in any room while holding everything you need close.

features.title: Soothing, warm tones
features.text: Cream and brown tones add a subtle, calming vibe that pairs effortlessly with modern and traditional settings.

features.title: Hassle-free setup
features.text: Tool-free, intuitive assembly makes it quick to put together and easier to move around as you refresh your space.

name: Upmods Prelaminated Particle Board Bedside Table
